messages:
Sam K: Updated PR #452 with the changes from the last review — removed the global cache flush, switched to a per-request TTL, and added unit + integration tests. PTAL when you have a minute: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/452 :eyes: CI is running but I wanted to flag the change earlier in case anyone has concerns about Dedicated toggles.

CI-bot: CI pipeline triggered for PR #452 — lint, unit-tests, integration-tests, benchmarks. Status: running.

Carla: quick q — does the per-request TTL affect model warmup behavior? I saw a new flag `--per-request-ttl` in the config; how would teams on Dedicated enable/disable this without a redeploy?

Sam K: Good q. The TTL is applied at request entry in the serving runtime (no global flush), so warmup is unchanged for pinned models. For Dedicated we expose it as a runtime config that can be toggled via the console / API: `PUT /v1/pools/{id}/config` with `per_request_ttl_ms`. Example:

```json
{"per_request_ttl_ms": 30000}
```

That avoids stack-level restarts; it's applied on the fly. Also added a short note in the PR description.

Ben: did you run the perf microbench against the baseline? any tail latency impact for 8k sequences?

Sam K: Yep — ran the usual TGAN microbench. Median token latency ~unchanged, p95 increased ~1.1% on P4-based infra (within noise). End-to-end throughput unaffected. Logs + raw numbers in the PR comments (bench run id: bench-20260315-452).

Lin: I left a tiny nit about `ttl_ms` vs `request_ttl_ms` naming — can we pick one consistent name? Also asked for a short comment on the public API change.

Sam K: Addressed both nits — renamed to `request_ttl_ms` everywhere and added the docstring you suggested. New commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/commit/7f3b2a9 (updates tests & changelog).

Carla: LGTM from me after CI green. No functional concerns.

Ben: Approving pending CI. If CI passes, can we merge today? Prefer after 13:00 PT to avoid the morning cut for Dedicated capacity changes.

Sam K: Yes — planning to merge around 13:30 PT if everything is green. I'll queue the merge and monitor staging.

CI-bot: All checks passed for PR #452 — lint ✅ unit-tests ✅ integration-tests ✅ benchmarks ✅.

Deploy Bot: Merge scheduled by Sam K for 1769705400 (13:30 PT). Will run pre-merge checks then merge and kick off the staging deployment.

Sam K: Merged and deployed to staging. Monitoring: no error-rate regressions so far, tail latency within expected range. Will promote to prod after one successful hour of smoke. :rocket:
